story: Azhar Shafi, 32, from Kazhakkottam, was seriously injured in a road accident in Marthandam on 22 October 2026.
He is in the ICU at Ananthapuri Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram, with a severe head injury and bleeding in the brain.
On the morning of the accident, he was travelling from Nagercoil to Thiruvananthapuram when his vehicle went out of control and struck the rear of a lorry parked by the roadside.

volunteer.heading: Take a step for Azhar
volunteer.intro: You can also volunteer to collect cash contributions locally for Azhar.
steps: Deposit the collected cash into your own bank account.
